visual_text: A time-limited trial, from agreement to review
Core items from the ATS 2024 consensus for intensive care (16 elements in full)
Agree: offered to the person or family, who can agree to it
Name: the treatment and how long it will run
Define: the signs that would show it is working or not
Review on the agreed date: carry on, stop and focus on comfort, or extend
Kruser et al., Ann Am Thorac Soc 2024
alt_text: Timeline from Start to Review date with a shaded treatment period and numbered markers 1 to 4, then three arrows to Carry on, Focus on comfort and Extend. Numbered list: agree, name, define the signs of working or not, and review on the agreed date.
